steps.title: Observe
steps.idea: You can't improve what you can't see. Instrument the app so every report it writes becomes a trace you can read.
steps.build: wrapOpenAI on the model client, traced + span.log around writeReport, and metadata describing each dog's day.
steps.beat: Every report we've ever written, with its cost and the data behind it.

steps.title: Score one thing
steps.idea: Turn a hunch into a number. Write one scorer in plain code and run your first experiment.
steps.build: A scorer that checks every number in a report appears in the day log, and an Eval() over the four dogs.
steps.beat: 67% — and here's the exact row that failed.

steps.title: Keep the hard cases
steps.idea: Four dogs isn't a test set. Build a dataset of deliberately awkward days that every future prompt has to survive.
steps.build: A Braintrust dataset: the four dogs plus nasty ones — nothing logged, contradictory entries, a day that's only an incident.
steps.beat: The awkward days are permanent now. Nothing can quietly break them again.

steps.title: Fix the prompt, prove it
steps.idea: Change the prompt with evidence instead of vibes, and find out what the fix broke.
steps.build: A second prompt version, a second experiment on the same dataset, and a row-by-row comparison.
steps.beat: v1 against v2, row by row — including what got worse.

steps.title: Judge what code can't
steps.idea: Some failures don't show up in a regex. Use a model as a judge, then check whether you agree with it.
steps.build: An LLM-as-judge scorer for buried medication and invented warmth, validated against your own ratings.
steps.beat: Code catches invented numbers. A judge catches buried medication.

steps.title: Ask the humans
steps.idea: The people reading the reports already know which ones are wrong. Capture that and feed it back.
steps.build: Thumbs up/down on the owner portal, a staff correction box, and feedback flowing into Braintrust and on into the dataset.
steps.beat: A complaint on Tuesday is a test case on Wednesday.

steps.title: Iterate without deploying
steps.idea: Prompt changes shouldn't need a code release. Move the prompt into Braintrust and work on it there.
steps.build: The app loading its prompt from Braintrust, iterated in the playground against real days, with models compared side by side.
steps.beat: Change the prompt, try it on 20 real days, ship it — no deploy.

steps.title: Watch production
steps.idea: Experiments tell you about the past. Score live traffic so you find out when quality moves, not weeks later.
steps.build: Scorers running automatically on new reports, and a dashboard of quality and cost per day.
steps.beat: Quality and cost per day, and an alert when either one moves.

steps.title: Ship it honestly
steps.idea: Make all of this routine: account for noise, block regressions, and know what runs before a prompt change goes out.
steps.build: A pre-ship check with trials and a regression gate, run through the bt CLI in CI — plus the demo run of show.
steps.beat: This is what runs before anyone touches the prompt.
